title: Regex scripts
subtitle: Find & replace in messages
meta: Automatic find & replace for chat messages
intro: A script finds text in messages and replaces it. Use them to restyle replies (status panels, phone messages, HUDs) or to remove clutter before it is sent to the model. Chat history itself is never changed.
presetsHint: Run only in chats that use this prompt. A SillyTavern preset brings its scripts along when you import it.
charactersHint: Come with a character card and run only in its chats.
noScriptsHint: Add one, or import a SillyTavern, Tavo or Lumiverse regex file.
importFailed: No regex scripts found in this file
deleteAllConfirm: Delete all {{count}} scripts in this list?

pending.title: A character card has scripts
pending.body: {{name}} came with {{count}} regex scripts. They can change how messages look and what is sent to the model. Allow them?

editor.name: Name
editor.findHint: A regular expression, like /<status>([\s\S]*?)<\/status>/g . Without slashes it is used as is.
editor.replaceHint: $1, $2 … insert captured groups; {{match}} is the whole match; {{user}} and {{char}} are names. Leave empty to delete what was found.
editor.displayHint: Changes how the message looks in the chat. The model still gets the original text.
editor.promptHint: Changes the text sent to the model. The chat still shows the original.
editor.bothHint: Changes the chat display and the text sent to the model.
editor.minDepthHint: 0 runs on every message. 3 leaves the three newest messages alone.
editor.maxDepthHint: Limit to this many messages back. Off runs on all.
editor.trimHint: Text removed from each captured group before it is inserted.
editor.testerHint: Paste a sample message. The result updates as you type.
editor.discardBody: Your changes to this script will be lost.
